newsitem.title: USA: Satellite deployment delayed until Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Satellite deployment delayed until Tuesday.

text.p: The launch of an unmanned Delta rocket to deploy five communications satellites was postponed until Tuesday because of software problems on the ground, the consortium that owns the satellites said on Sunday.
Iridium LLC, an international group of 18 telecommunications organizations, said the launch had been planned for Sunday from Vandenberg Air Force Base in California.

The consortium, which includes Motorola Inc., has already deployed 17 of a planned eventual network of 66 communications satellites that will allow customers to use handheld telephones and pagers anywhere in the world.
Commercial service is scheduled to begin in September 1998, an Iridium spokeswoman said.
